generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)
Before and after GPS Photographs shall be submitted
Bidders are bond the guidelines / instructions issued time to from the government
If any date in the tender time table is government holidays, nest working date will be considered
Corrigendums / modifications / correction if any will be published in the website only
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The Employer reserves the rights to reject any of all tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Tenderer shall have valid class - III KPWD
In any TWO financial year out of last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number compulsory
As prime contractor at least one similar work such as of value not less than 50 percentage of amount put tender last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26not below rank of Executive Engineer
Assessed available tender capacity computed as per the formula in section 3.6
after reading the terms and conditions as per the bid documents. submit the bidders declaration on a letterhead.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rejuvenation and Repairs of 28 Nos OHTs at various villages in Jewargi Taluka under Non SDP EAP

itemList.description: Work 1: Repairs of OHT at Varchanalli, Mudbal.K, Shakapur SA, Kellur and Gudur SA village of Jewargi Taluka (5 OHTs, A.A. Sl. 7, Jewargi Sub-Division 0.93 L model - type A x 5 OHTs [no Non-SDP estimate received - Jewargi type A adopted]) - Providing and fixing hand rail of approved size by welding etc. to steel ladder railing, balcony railing, staircase railing and similar works, including applying priming coat of approved steel primer. M.S. tube including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. (PWD CSR 2021-22 Vol-II Pg.No.84 Sl.No.11.26.1)

Providing and applying composite waterproofing compound as impregnate only on wet surfaces to arrest leaks in surfaces such as roof cealing, internal and external walls, flooring and other surfaces apart from water tanks, sumps, reservoirs, by mixing the composite waterproofing compound with water in ratio of 1:10 to make a workable slurry and pouring it on all cleaned and prepared corners and disturbed area and further mixing in the ration 1:20 and pouring it on the prepared surface by cleaning the surface with etchant chemical from dirt foreign materials etc.,and allowing it to be there upto 3 hours and then cleaning the same using water complete as per spcification so that the surface is got back and ready to use after 4 hours. [KRDWS and S SOR - 2019-20 ,It.No.9.69. Page no-59]

Ladder inside the container: Providing anodised ladder using 65mm x 32mm x 3mm C section for ladder side channel x 25mm dia., fluteL pipe for Rungs at 250 mm c/c leather fixed at an angle of 70 deg to horizontal including necessary 25mm dia., G.I. shutters with necessary fastners for bracing the ladders to the tank walls to prevent buckling of the ladder with necessary (M-15) bed for embedding the ladder bottom complete. [BWSSB SOR 21-22 P-Corrigendum No.222 Date:07/06/2022 I.No.H270]

Providing and fixing 60x60cms M.S. inspection door with necessary M.S. frame made out of M.S. angle 50x50x6mm and M.S. shutters of 31.5mm or B.G.10 thick with hinges on top and locking arrangement, painting etc., complete (for RCC over head tank and G.L.S.R.) [BWSSB SOR-21-22 P.N. 111 I -13 H140A]
